newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian foreign reserves hit new high.
newsitem.headline: Colombian foreign reserves hit new high.

text.p: BOGOTA, June 11 Reuter - Colombia's net foreign reserves hit a record high of $10.204 billion on May 23, the latest date for which official figures are available, the central bank said.
It said net reserves had grown by $36.8 million between May 16-23 and by $307.9 million, or 3.1 percent since Dec. 30.
The bank estimates that net reserves will expand by $750 million this year.
